$comment: Reviewed-and-accepted npm advisories, consumed by scripts/audit-advisories.mjs.
This is the npm-side counterpart to deny.toml's [advisories] ignore list, and the
same discipline applies: an advisory is only silenced with a written reason and a
'expires' is REQUIRED and enforced. Once the date passes, the advisory counts
against the gate again and the report says the acceptance expired. Set it to the
date the blocker is expected to clear, not to a comfortable distance.
